Property Management Consultation

Hourly consultation on rent policy, tenant relations, property maintenance schedules, compliance procedures, and operational best practices.

Why You Need This Service

Property management has a lot of moving parts. You're not just charging rent — you're managing relationships, handling repairs, staying compliant, and staying profitable. Common questions:

  • What should my rent policy be across multiple properties?
  • How do I handle difficult tenants professionally?
  • What maintenance schedule should I follow?
  • How do I stay compliant with Act 220?
  • What's the best way to collect rent?
  • How much should I charge for late payment?
  • When should I replace vs. repair?

This consultation answers these questions with practical, experience-based advice.

Topics We Cover

  • Rent Policy: How to set and adjust rent consistently
  • Tenant Relations: Professional communication and boundary-setting
  • Rent Collection: Best practices for on-time payment
  • Maintenance: Preventive schedule vs. emergency repairs
  • Compliance: Documentation and notification procedures
  • Problem Solving: Handling specific issues you're facing
  • Systems: How to organize your property management

What You Get

  • Expert Guidance: Practical advice based on experience
  • Customized Approach: Solutions tailored to your situation
  • Best Practices: How successful landlords operate
  • Templates & Tools: Sample policies, communication templates
  • Problem-Solving: Concrete solutions to your specific challenges

When You Need This Service

  • You're managing multiple properties and want consistency
  • You're struggling with difficult tenants
  • You want to improve your systems and procedures
  • You're thinking about hiring a property manager and want to know what to expect
  • You want professional advice on a specific management challenge

Who Benefits Most

Landlords managing 3+ properties. If you have multiple units, investing in good management systems saves time and prevents disputes. A consultation often pays for itself in reduced conflict and smoother operations.

Pricing & Turnaround

GHS 250 per hour

Sessions typically 1–2 hours

Scheduling: By appointment (we work around your schedule)
